rows.en: Wow… Remembering Daisaku's birthday wherever he is… What a kind father, huh?

Whoa, amazing! A life-size model of an android? I'm impressed…

All riiight, Daisaku! I'll help you put it together!

No way!

The fun of a model is building it by yourself.
Aww, too bad…
The fun birthday party ended, and young Daisaku began assembling the life-size android his father had sent as a present.
Blueprints in one hand and his father's face in his mind, young Daisaku steadily put the model together…

There, it's done! Let's see, "press the button on its chest and the model will move"…

This one!
Ha ha ha ha ha!

Ah!?

Who are you…? Hey, give back my wristwatch!
I am Daisaku Kusama… U7 of the Unicorn Agency's Japan Branch. I've taken your wristwatch, as you can see!
N-nonsense! I'm Daisaku Kusama! Give back my wristwatch!
Ah, wait! You're not getting away!
This is bad! Oyassan!!

What's wrong, Taki?

…Oh, no, I mean, Takeshi? Did something happen?

Something was bothering me…

so I checked up on the manufacturer of the model Daisaku received… The company that makes that model doesn't exist anywhere.
What!?
Then that means…

For Daisaku's present to be delivered here… I thought it was strange!

There must be some scheme behind this!
If we don't hurry, Daisaku's in danger!

Stop this pointless struggle…

You are me, and I am you… When two identical people fight, there can be no winner.
You won't know until you try!

…!?

Is that Daisaku?
No, wait a second! There are two Daisakus!?
[HERO2], [HERO4]! It's me! I'm the real Daisaku Kusama! I'm U7!!
You've got to be kidding me? What on earth is going on?
It's true… Only one of them is wearing the wristwatch.
So that's the hard evidence, huh…

No…

The fake is the one wearing the wristwatch! It has no life signs!

Thank you, [HERO4]!

Now, you fake! I'm getting my wristwatch back!!
Daisaku… you're a twin? I didn't know that!

You're right…

They're twins, so of course they would, but they really look exactly alike, huh? Maybe it's a sibling squabble?
Seriously? What the heck is going on?
You're right… Only one of them is wearing the wristwatch.

Not quite…

The fake is the one wearing the wristwatch! This "feeling" isn't a human one. And besides…
What?
…I mean, his eyebrows are too thick.
I am Daisaku Kusama, U7.
I'm the real…

No, you're wrong…

Daisaku Kusama, U7, is me. And as proof, I have the wristwatch for giving orders to Robo!
Damn… That's mine! Give it back!!
Damn…
Ah, wait!
Heh heh heh…
Who are you?

I am… Space Monster Doctor Gelma of the Fourth-Dimension Nebula!

It seems I underestimated the power of Earthlings! This time… I shall show you the might of the Space Monster Doctor! Giant Robo will be mine, without fail!
I won't let you do that!
Ha ha ha ha…

Yeah…

I think it was probably a scheme by that Space Monster Doctor Gelma…
We saw through the fake, but it got away. And Daisaku's wristwatch is still stolen…
Gigant was with them too… There's no doubt that Emperor Guillotine and Naager have joined hands.
Unless we defeat that fake… we can no longer count on Giant Robo being on humanity's side.

Yes…

I think it was probably a scheme by that Space Monster Doctor Gelma…

I'm the one who saw through the fake, you know.

But it got away. And it stole Daisaku's wristwatch too…
That Gigant was with them too… Could it be that Emperor Guillotine and Naager have joined hands?
Unless we defeat that fake… we can't say Giant Robo is on our side, can we?
What!? There were two Daisakus?
Then what are they…?
Most likely… they mean to use the wristwatch to take Giant Robo back.
Take it back?

That's right…

Originally… Giant Robo was a robot built by BF. A robot Emperor Guillotine had them build.
BF?
Big Fire. It's a mixed organization made up of Emperor Guillotine's alien army and Earthlings who sold their souls to it.

Doktor Garuchua was the father of Giant Robo.

The FBI was searching for him at the time, since he'd been kidnapped by BF. Unfortunately, the doctor was found dead…
Then it was that doctor who gave Giant Robo to Daisaku?
At the cost of his life, he entrusted humanity's peace to Daisaku.
Emperor Guillotine…
Ah, Daisaku Kusama! Doctor Gelma, what is the meaning of this?

This is not U7! With my power, even copying a human is possible.

Now, Android U7! Summon Giant Robo here!
Yes. Fly… fly… Giant Robo…
How is it?

Good thing we noticed in time…

Branch Chief, I've cut all of Robo's power. Robo won't move now.
That was close… Giant Robo very nearly fell into Emperor Guillotine's hands.

But… unless we get the wristwatch back from my fake soon…

Robo is as good as dead!
Fly… fly… Giant Robo…
What is this? It isn't flying!
Ugh, well, you see…
You've failed, haven't you?
Emperor Guillotine… Please, give me just one more chance!
Very well! Do not fail this time!

uncertain: U07868: the look-alike claims to be the real Daisaku; translated as said.
U07872: Tachibana first mistakes Takeshi for Taki (滝?…あ、いや、猛?); kept.
U07886/U07892/U07908: the fake referred to as "it" (no life signs); U07894 [HERO4] says "his eyebrows" since it looks like Daisaku.
U07889: [HERO2]'s two-route lines; the joke assumes they are twins.
U07919/U07920/U07922: BF団 rendered "BF" per glossary; U07921 spells out "Big Fire" (glossary note) where Kotaro asks what it is.
U07922: ドクトル・ガルチュア博士 rendered "Doktor Garuchua" (Doktor as in Doktor G).
